stories.title: Relatório de intervenção no Consórcio Guaicurus aponta caos financeiro, frota sucateada e falhas de gestão

en.title: Report on Consórcio Guaicurus intervention points to financial chaos, scrapped fleet and management failures
en.summary: Three months after intervention in Consórcio Guaicurus, a report reveals financial problems, deteriorated fleet conditions, and management failures in Campo Grande's public transportation. The document was delivered to municipal authorities and city council.

stories.title: Corpos de Rick e outros 4 mortos em queda de helicóptero chegam ao IML; acompanhe a cobertura

en.title: Bodies of Rick and 4 others killed in helicopter crash arrive at IML; follow coverage
en.summary: A helicopter carrying singer Rick crashed in Urubici, Santa Catarina, killing five people including businessman Bruno Avelar and videomaker Paulo Soares. A two-day search using thermal technology preceded the discovery.

stories.title: Primeira escola cívico-militar municipal tem início previsto para 2027 em Rio Preto

en.title: First municipal civic-military school scheduled to begin in 2027 in Rio Preto
en.summary: São José do Rio Preto announced its first municipal civic-military school, set to open in 2027 with extended hours and capacity for 490 students. The facility will operate in the Eng. Schmitt neighborhood.

stories.title: CEO da Novo Nordisk diz que pílulas podem capturar 50% do mercado de remédios para emagrecer até 2030

en.title: Novo Nordisk CEO says pills could capture 50% of weight-loss drug market by 2030
en.summary: Novo Nordisk's chief executive predicts that pill-based weight-loss medications could capture up to half the global obesity drug market by 2030. The Danish company is positioning itself for a shift away from weekly injections.

stories.title: Câmara de BH aprova em 2º turno reajuste de 4,11% para servidores da prefeitura

en.title: Belo Horizonte City Council approves 4.11% salary increase for municipal employees in second round
en.summary: Belo Horizonte's city council voted to approve a 4.11% salary increase for municipal employees and public workers in the second round of voting, passing with 40 favorable votes.

stories.title: Channing Tatum nega usar perfil fake para atacar Zoë Kravitz e Harry Styles

en.title: Channing Tatum denies using fake profile to attack Zoë Kravitz and Harry Styles
en.summary: Actor Channing Tatum denied operating a fake Instagram account used to post comments about his former fiancée Zoë Kravitz and her current partner Harry Styles.

stories.title: Gilmar tenta levar ao plenário do STF caso de usinas que expõe relação de ministros com Vorcaro

en.title: Gilmar attempts to bring to Supreme Court plenary case involving power plants that exposes ministers' relationship with Vorcaro
en.summary: Brazilian Supreme Court Justice Gilmar Mendes sought to move a major ruling involving the sugarcane sector to the court's full plenary, amid tensions between different factions of justices.

stories.title: Sem Marta, seleção brasileira feminina enfrenta Argentina em amistosos

en.title: Without Marta, Brazilian women's national team faces Argentina in friendlies
en.summary: Brazil's women's soccer coach announced the squad for matches against Argentina in October without veteran player Marta, preparing for the 2027 World Cup.

stories.title: Formato novo e prêmio em dinheiro: o que esperar das Eliminatórias para a Copa de 2030

en.title: New format and prize money: what to expect from the 2030 World Cup Qualifiers
en.summary: The 2030 World Cup Qualifiers will feature a new format and monetary prizes for participating teams.

stories.title: Estêvão tenta se blindar contra lesões para se firmar na seleção brasileira

en.title: Estêvão seeks to protect himself against injuries to establish himself in the Brazilian national team
en.summary: After recovering from a muscle injury that sidelined him from the World Cup, Estêvão returns to the Brazilian squad aiming to increase his playing time with Chelsea.

stories.title: Arthur Elias convoca seleção feminina para amistosos contra Argentina

en.title: Arthur Elias calls up women's national team for friendlies against Argentina
en.summary: Coach Arthur Elias selected 28 players for Brazil's women's football team to face Argentina in two October home matches, including goalkeeper Yanne and three sub-20 returnees.

stories.title: Gilmar pede análise no plenário do STF de disputa de usinas que beneficiaria Vorcaro

en.title: Gilmar requests Supreme Court plenary analysis of power plant dispute that would benefit Vorcaro
en.summary: Supreme Court Justice Gilmar Mendes requested a plenary ruling on a high-value case involving the sugarcane sector, positioning him against colleagues including Kassio Nunes Marques amid court tensions.

stories.title: Candidatos a senador pelo Maranhão (MA): veja a lista atualizada das eleições 2026

en.title: Candidates for senator in Maranhão (MA): see the updated list for 2026 elections
en.summary: Maranhão has 11 registered candidates competing for two Federal Senate seats in the 2026 elections scheduled for October 4, with approximately 5.2 million eligible voters.

stories.title: Temperatta amplia portfólio personalizado e aposta em combos

en.title: Temperatta expands customized portfolio and bets on combos
en.summary: Temperatta, a private label supplier to retailers, is expanding its customized product portfolio and plans to boost year-end sales through combo packs and kits targeting e-commerce channels.

stories.title: Candidatos a senador por Santa Catarina (SC): veja lista atualizada das eleições 2026

en.title: Candidates for senator in Santa Catarina (SC): see updated list for 2026 elections
en.summary: Santa Catarina has 13 registered candidates competing for two Federal Senate seats in the 2026 elections scheduled for October 4, with approximately 5.7 million eligible voters.

stories.title: Candidatos a senador pelo Pará (PA): veja a lista atualizada das eleições 2026

en.title: Candidates for senator in Pará (PA): see the updated list for 2026 elections
en.summary: Pará has 13 registered candidates competing for two Federal Senate seats in the 2026 elections scheduled for October 4, with approximately 6.3 million eligible voters.

stories.title: Candidatos a senador pelo Ceará (CE): veja a lista atualizada das eleições 2026

en.title: Candidates for senator in Ceará (CE): see the updated list for the 2026 elections
en.summary: Ceará has 8 registered candidates competing for two Senate seats in the 2026 elections, with nearly 7 million eligible voters. The first round of voting will take place on October 4.
